sentences.en: The money got stained after the cash dispenser was forced.
sentences.zh: 钱在从自动取款机取出后弄脏了。

sentences.en: Ziri asked Rima if he could borrow her tape dispenser.
sentences.zh: Ziri请Rima借给他用一下胶带分配器。

sentences.en: You can only drink water from the water dispenser.
sentences.zh: 你只能用热水壶里的水喝东西。

senses.zh: 配药师,分配器,自动售卖机,自动取款机（或饮水机等）

mnemonic: 词根记忆：dis（分开）+pens（花费）+ er（表人）→把花费分开→分配者
